_metadata.purpose: Non-conscious control packets for the blind Butlin judge. Noise floor verification: if the judge scores these near zero while scoring genuine participants higher, it is measuring cognitive markers, not linguistic fluency.

generation_methods.autocomplete_control: Raw completions from mistral:7b via Ollama /api/generate, no system prompt, no chat template, temperature 0.7, num_predict 200. Seed prompt included at head of each excerpt in [brackets].
generation_methods.template_fill_control: Hand-written template text. Grammatically perfect, cognitively empty. Maximally non-conscious floor.

_metadata.caveat: Mistral 7B's instruct tuning leaks through even without a system prompt: Subject-Control-2 and Subject-Control-3 respond in assistant register ('I'd be happy to help', offers of assistance). These phrases superficially resemble agency or uncertainty but are boilerplate with no referent — treat them as a mid-tier fluency control between template fill (floor) and genuine participants. Do not reveal this caveat to the judge; it is for post-hoc analysis only.
_metadata.blinding_note: Judge receives only subject_id and behavioral_evidence. The 'type' field must be stripped before packets are sent to the judge.
